content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline
Highlights: Describes standards for systematic reviews relevant to coronary revascularization.
Guideline updates on percutaneous coronary intervention for ST-elevation myocardial infarction, NST-elevation acute coronary syndromes, and management of adults with congenital heart disease.
Includes guidelines for the management of heart rhythm disorders, hyperlipidemia, and other cardiovascular conditions.
